assays.assay_description: C57BL/6J mice with head-mounted magnets placed in a glass cylinder surrounded by a magnetometer coil; HTR counted over 30 min following s.c. administration of 25CN-NBMD (0.3-30 mg/kg) or vehicle.

application_type.evidence: administered SC at a volume of 5 mL/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: Methods do not describe pre-test apparatus habituation

setup_restrain.evidence: HTR activity was recorded in a glass cylinder surrounded by a magnetometer coil

food_restriction.evidence: food and water provided ad libitum except during behavioral testing

water_restriction.evidence: food and water provided ad libitum except during behavioral testing

time_to_assay.evidence: Test compounds were injected immediately prior to testing.

sample_size.evidence: Mice (32 total, n = 5-6/group) were injected with 25CN-NBMD

outcomes.summary: 25CN-NBMD produced a dose-dependent, biphasic increase in head-twitch response in male C57BL/6J mice with a maximal response at 10 mg/kg (ED50 = 2.16 mg/kg). 25CN-NBOH was ~4-fold more potent (ED50 = 0.51 mg/kg).
outcomes.evidence: 25CN-NBMD produced a dose-dependent increase in HTR (drug effect: F5,26 = 11.62; p < 0.0001) ... maximal response occurring at 10 mg/kg

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The entire 30-min recordings were examined for head twitches (total counts)

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours

B5_social.evidence: Individual testing in a glass cylinder

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR does not require learning or memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: HTRs were identified by waveform characteristics from magnetometer coil voltage — signal-based detection, not video behavioural classification

B8_multivariate.evidence: Head twitch counts analyzed by one-way ANOVA

E1_environment_type.evidence: glass cylinder surrounded by a magnetometer coil

E8_food_water.evidence: food and water provided ad libitum except during behavioral testing

D1_continuity.evidence: HTR activity was recorded ... for 30 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single HTR test session per condition

D4_baseline.evidence: Test compounds were injected immediately prior to testing

assays.assay_description: Female NMRI mice tested individually in a type III H cage with 20 glass marbles on a 4.5 cm sawdust layer for 30 min following i.p. 25CN-NBOH (1, 3, 10 mg/kg) or DOI (0.1, 0.3, 1 mg/kg); buried marbles (>2/3 covered) counted by blinded observer at 10, 20 and 30 min.

application_type.evidence: administered i.p. 15 min and 30 min prior to testing, respectively

setup_habituation.evidence: The mice were not acclimatized to the test cages

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were freely moving in type III H cages

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum (home cage); no food in the test cage during the 30-min session

water_restriction.evidence: No water bottle in test cage during 30-min session

time_to_assay.evidence: 25CN-NBOH and DOI ... administered i.p. 15 min and 30 min prior to testing, respectively

sample_size.evidence: n = 10 (per group, for each drug, 4 groups each)

outcomes.summary: Both 25CN-NBOH (1, 3, 10 mg/kg) and DOI (0.1, 0.3, 1 mg/kg) produced dose-dependent decreases in marble burying in female NMRI mice. 25CN-NBOH significantly reduced cumulative buried marbles at 10 mg/kg; DOI at 0.3 and 1 mg/kg.
outcomes.statistics: 25CN-NBOH cumulative: F3,36 = 3.39, p < 0.05 (10 mg/kg p < 0.01); time × treatment F6,72 = 5.43, p < 0.001. DOI cumulative: F3,36 = 9.50, p < 0.001 (0.3 mg/kg p < 0.05; 1 mg/kg p < 0.001); time × treatment F6,72 = 2.49, p < 0.05
outcomes.evidence: 25CN-NBOH ... produced a dose-dependent decrease in total digging during the test ... DOI ... also produced a dose-dependent decrease in total digging during the MB test

B1_num_measures.evidence: The number of buried marbles served as a measure of perseverative MB behaviour

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: MB data are analyzed and presented as both time-course and total effect ... digging in time bins was analysed by two-way repeated measures ANOVA

B4_ethological.evidence: The MB test measures compulsive-like digging — a natural digging behaviour

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Marbles counted by an observer blinded to the treatment

E3_bedding.evidence: a layer of 4.5 cm saw dust

E5_enrichment.evidence: Marbles are the test stimulus, not enrichment

D2_session_duration.evidence: counted ... at the 10, 20, and 30-min time points

assays.assay_description: Female NMRI mice placed in transparent type III H cages on a black background; movement recorded for 30 min by overhead camera using EthoVision XT after i.p. 25CN-NBOH (1, 3, 10 mg/kg) or DOI (0.1, 0.3, 1 mg/kg); distance travelled measured.

application_type.evidence: administered i.p. 15 min and 30 min prior to testing, respectively

setup_habituation.evidence: The mice were not acclimatized to the test cages and the recording was started immediately after placing the animals in the test cages

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were freely moving in the test cages

food_restriction.evidence: No food in test cage during 30-min session

water_restriction.evidence: No water in test cage during 30-min session

time_to_assay.evidence: 25CN-NBOH and DOI ... administered i.p. 15 min and 30 min prior to testing, respectively

outcomes.summary: Neither 25CN-NBOH nor DOI produced significant changes in total distance travelled in female NMRI mice. There was a near-significant trend toward increased activity with 0.3 and 1 mg/kg DOI.
outcomes.evidence: one-way ANOVAs revealed no significant main effects of 25CN-NBOH treatment (F3,28 = 0.93; p = 0.441) or DOI treatment (F3,25 = 1.81; p = 0.171) on total distance travelled

B1_num_measures.evidence: Distance travelled served as a measure of LA

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: total distance analysed by one-way ANOVA

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance is explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours

B7_automated_classification.evidence: EthoVision XT is a position-tracking system (score-0 list)

E1_environment_type.evidence: transparent type III H cages on a black background

E3_bedding.evidence: LA cage described on a black background; no sawdust mentioned for LA test

D4_baseline.evidence: Recording started immediately after placing the animals in the test cages (post-injection)

judge_notes: Three behavioural assays retained: HTR (in C57BL/6J males), marble burying (NMRI females), and locomotor activity (NMRI females). All other study content (cell-based binding, functional assays, radioligand binding, autoradiography, SAR/chemistry) is non-behavioural and excluded.

B7 for HTR set to 0: magnetometer waveform detection is a signal-based event detector, not a video-based behavioural classifier of the type rewarded by B7 (DeepLabCut/SLEAP/MoSeq/B-SOiD/SimBA). Overrode gptoss candidate.

E3 for LA set to 0: paper describes LA in 'transparent type III H cages on a black background' with no mention of sawdust for the LA assay (sawdust is specified only for MB). Overrode gptoss candidate.

day_night_flipped set to 'yes' based on explicit reversed-cycle statement for the HTR cohort (C57BL/6J at UCSD). NMRI mice were on standard cycle; reported the explicit reversed cycle for HTR cohort as the housing statement, since at least one cohort was on reversed cycle.
Sex n: HTR n=32 (male), MB n=40 female, LA n=~31 female (n=7-8 × 4 groups × 2 drugs). Approximate female total ≈ 71.
